How to build apps with Abacus AI Deep Agent?â

How does Abacus AI Deep Agent help with vibe coding?â

Abacus AI Deep Agent helps you get started with vibe coding. Start with something simple and then learn how to nudge the AI to make changes, fix bugs, and iterate.

Abacus AI Deep Agent is meant for full-stack apps but we will start with simple apps and front-end heavy websites.

How does it work?â

Here are the steps to using Abacus AI Deep Agent to create apps:

  1. Start with a simple prompt
  2. Check out the pages that the AI built
  3. Ask the AI to make edits
  4. When you are ready, hit deploy to publish the app
  5. We will give you a friendly URL to share with the world. You can also host your apps on custom domains that you own.

What are the key capabilities of Abacus AI Deep Agentâ

  • Database + Auth Support: Build apps with built-in database integration and secure, reliable authentication. No setup needed.
  • LLM-Enabled Apps: Add AI chat, document Q&A, or generation features to your app. Abacus AI Deep Agent can integrate LLMs right into the flow.
  • Checkpointing & Deployments: Make changes, preview versions, and deploy the one you like â instantly. Iterate at the speed of thought.
  • Custom Domain Publishing: Host your app on your own domain. Provide the domain on the Abacus AI Deep Agent platform and complete the simple integration â your app goes live with a custom URL in minutes.

Limitations of Abacus AI Deep Agentâ

While Abacus AI Deep Agent is powerful and evolving fast, there are a few limitations to keep in mind:

  • Abacus AI Deep Agent works best with small to medium-sized applications. Extremely complex or enterprise-grade apps may go beyond its current capabilities.
  • If your project involves uploading or unpacking large zip files, or building on top of pre-existing codebases, Abacus AI Deep Agent won't be able to handle those scenarios yet.

We're actively working on expanding what Abacus AI Deep Agent can doâbut for now, it's ideal for rapid prototyping, MVPs, and simpler full-stack apps.

Managing Your Appsâ

All the apps you create with Abacus AI Deep Agent can be accessed and managed easily through the Apps Management Console.

From there, you can:

  • View and edit all your created apps
  • Preview apps before deploying
  • View database
  • Deploy or un-deploy apps anytime
  • Access version history to view or revert changes
  • Configure and manage custom domains

Whether you're refining an existing app or managing multiple projects, the console gives you full control in one place.

How to Add a Database to Your App?â

If your app requires a database, you don't need to worry about setting one up yourself. Just mention your data needs in your prompt, and Abacus AI Deep Agent will create the necessary database for you, including tables, fields, and sample data when needed.

Once the app is created successfully, you can view/export the database from Apps Management Console or respective Abacus AI Deep Agent conversation.

App deployment & hostingâ

With Abacus AI Deep Agent, deploying your app is incredibly simple.

Abacus hosted domainâ

Use this if you want a fast, no-setup way to get your app online.

  1. Click the "Deploy" button in the top-right corner of your App workspace.
  2. Select the "Abacus.AI Domain" tab.
  3. Enter your desired subdomain (e.g., mycoolapp.abacusai.app) in the input box.
  4. Click "Deploy".

Custom Domainâ

Point your existing domain to the app by updating your nameservers through your domain provider.

Step 1: Register Your Custom Domain

  1. Pick a domain name relevant to your app.
  2. Use a registrar like GoDaddy, Namecheap, or Google Domains to purchase it.
  3. Register the domain, ensuring your contact details are correct. Save your login credentials for later use.

Step 2: Connect and Deploy with Abacus AI Deep Agent

  1. Open the chat where your app is being built or a custom domain in the apps management console.
  2. Click the "Deploy" button.
  3. Select the "Custom Domain" tab.
  4. Add your domain and follow the instructions to verify it by updating the nameservers in your registrar dashboard.
  5. Once verified, click "Deploy" and your app will be live on your domain!

Once deployed, you'll find your live app's link under the "Deployed URL" section.

Follow these tips to unlock the full potential of Abacus AI Deep Agent.â

Vibe Coding Guideâ

Effective Prompting: Crisp, Concise, and Contextualâ

Your app is only as good as the instructions you give it. That's why we recommend following:

  • Crisp â Keep your prompt clean and free from fluff.
  • Concise â Use simple language and get to the point quickly.
  • Contextual â Make sure Abacus AI Deep Agent understands what you're trying to build. Share any relevant background and context.

The more clearly you explain what you want, the more likely you are to get the results you're aiming for.

Build Iteratively with Checkpointsâ

Don't try to build everything at onceâbuild your app step by step.

Before you start prompting, take a moment to think like a product manager or engineer. Break down your app idea into smaller parts or milestones. Then, build and test one part at a time.

Here's a simple flow to follow:

  1. Break it down â Split complex features into small, manageable tasks.
  2. Prompt the AI â Ask Abacus AI Deep Agent to build just one task at a time.
  3. Test immediately â Use the preview window to check if it works the way you expect.
  4. Decide â
    • If it works: great! Move on to the next task.
    • If it doesn't: roll back and try again.

Abacus AI Deep Agent automatically saves your progress as checkpoints, like save-points in a game. You can roll back up to the last 5 checkpoints, so make sure to test after each step. That way, you won't lose a version that was working well.

Building in small steps keeps things stable, makes debugging easier, and helps you stay in control.

Authentication and RBAC Made Easyâ

Abacus AI Deep Agent takes the pain out of setting up login and access control.

With built-in support for Authentication and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), you don't need to worry about technical setup or third-party tools. There's no coding, no configuration, and no external integrations required.

Just describe what kind of login system or access control you want in your prompt, and Abacus AI Deep Agent will handle the restâquickly and securely.

Built-In Database Supportâ

Need a database? Abacus AI Deep Agent sets it up for youâautomatically.â

If your app requires a database, you don't need to worry about setting one up yourself. Just mention your data needs in your prompt, and Abacus AI Deep Agent will create the necessary database for you, including tables, fields, and sample data when needed.

Sometimes, you might notice the app using dummy data instead of a real databaseâespecially in early versions or quick mockups. If that happens, simply prompt the AI with something like: "Set up a real database and connect it to this app."

Abacus AI Deep Agent will replace the dummy data with a proper backend setup so your app is ready for real users and dynamic content.

Launch your app in one clickâno setup, no stressâ

With Abacus AI Deep Agent, deploying your app is incredibly simple. You can publish it instantly using a free Abacus-hosted domainâperfect for quick demos, testing, or sharing your work.

Want to use your own domain?â
  • Custom Domain â Point your existing domain to the app by updating your nameservers through your domain provider.

Whether you're launching something personal, professional, or experimental, Abacus AI Deep Agent makes deployment effortless.

Debugging Your Appâ

When you're vibe coding, a few errors are totally normalâdon't panic!

If something breaks or doesn't work as expected, Abacus AI Deep Agent can help you fix it. Here's what to do when things go off track:

How to Debug with Abacus AI Deep Agent:â
  • Describe the issue clearly - Tell Abacus AI Deep Agent what's going wrong and where it's happening on your app (e.g., "The submit button isn't working on the form"). The clearer you are, the better the fix.
  • Copy error messages into the prompt- If you see an error in the preview window, copy and paste the full message into your prompt. Abacus AI Deep Agent can often identify and correct the issue directly from that.
  • Use checkpoints to roll back- If things get too messy, just revert to a previous checkpoint and rebuild from a stable version. It's like a built-in safety net.
  • Always re-test after debugging- Once you've made a fix, test the app thoroughly to make sure everything works as expected before moving forward.

Remember: errors are part of the process. The key is to fix, test, and keep iterating with confidence.

By following these tips, you can make the most out of Abacus AI Deep Agent's powerful capabilities. Happy vibe coding!

If you're still stuck, contact support â we're here for you.

App Deployment and Custom Domains

Once you have built your app using Abacus AI Deep Agent, the next step is to deploy it so that your users can access it through a public URL. Whether you are sharing an early version with your team or launching a fully developed application for wider use, this guide will walk you through each part of the deployment process.

This document includes:

  1. Introduction to Deployments
  2. Deployment on Abacus.AI
  3. Deployment on Custom Domains
  4. Deployment on custom Subdomain
  5. Frequently Asked Questions

1. Introduction to Deploymentsâ

Abacus.AI offers three ways to deploy your application. Use the table below to decide which option works best for your needs:

OptionAbacus.AI domainCustom DomainCustom SubDomain
Example URLyoursite.abacusai.appyoursite.comapp.yoursite.com
Best forQuick demos, testing, or sharing your work without setupWhen you want to host your app on a custom domain / personalized web addressWhen you already have a website and want to host the app on a subdomain
Domain OwnershipNo domain purchase requiredYou must own the domain and verify it with Abacus.AIYou must own the subdomain and verify the subdomain with Abacus.AI
Set up requirementsNo setup neededYou need to update NS / Cname records for the domainYou need to update NS / Cname records for the subdomain

2. Deployment on Abacus.AIâ

Follow these steps to deploy your application on the default Abacus.AI domain.â

Step 1: Start the Deploymentâ

Click the Deploy button located in the top right corner of your app interface.

Step 2: Choose Domain Typeâ

A pop-up window will appear with domain options. Select Abacus.AI as your deployment type.

Step 3: Enter Your Subdomainâ

In the input box, type your desired subdomain.

For example: myapp.abacusai.app, Then click Deploy to publish your application.

Step 4: Test Your Deployed Appâ

Once deployed, a public URL will be generated and displayed in the Deployed URL field. Open this link in your browser to test and share your app. It may take a few minutes (~5 minutes) for your URL to be active.

3. Deployment on custom Domainsâ

Deployment Guideâ

Step 1: Add a Custom Domainâ
  • Click on Deploy button on your apps conversation
  • Select the custom domains tab and click on Manage Domains button.
  • Click on the Add New button and enter your domain name
Step 2: Update DNS Records and Verify Ownershipâ

You can verify your domain by choosing one of the two options based on your domain providers. While most providers work with either flow, some have restrictions:

A. Automatic Configuration

We have partnered with Entri to offer seamless domain DNS configuration. You just need to single sign-on (SSO) to your domain provider using Entri, and your DNS records will be automatically added.

B. Manual Configuration

Based on your domain provider, you may use one of two methods to verify your domain:

  1. Nameservers / NS records ( Recommended for GoDaddy, Squarespace, Porkbun, Hostinger, etc. ) : Point your domain to Abacus.AI nameservers for full DNS management directly from the Abacus.AI dashboard.

  2. CNAME records (Recommended for Cloudflare, Namecheap, etc.) : Keep DNS management with your provider. Add CNAME records to connect your domain to Abacus.AI.

Note:
For subdomains corresponding to domains purchased through Abacus.AI or domains verified using Nameservers - Your subdomains will be automatically configured without any actions from your side

Step 3: Deploy Your Appâ
  • After successful verification, your domain will appear in the Verified Domains list.
  • Select the desired domain and click Deploy.
  • Your application will now be live and accessible via your chosen URL.

4. Deployment on custom Subdomainâ

Deployment Guideâ

Step 1: Add a Custom Subdomainâ
  • Click on Deploy button on your apps conversation
  • Select the custom domains tab and click on Manage Domains button.
  • Click on the Add New button and enter your domain name
Step 2: Update DNS Records and Verify Ownershipâ

You can verify your subdomain by choosing one of the two options:

A. Automatic Configuration

We have partnered with Entri to offer seamless domain DNS configuration. You just need to single sign-on (SSO) to your domain provider using Entri, and your DNS records will be automatically added.

B. Manual Configuration

Add CNAME records to connect your subdomain to Abacus.AI.

Note:
For subdomains corresponding to domains purchased through Abacus.AI or domains verified using Nameservers - Your subdomains will be automatically configured without any actions from your side

Step 3: Deploy Your Appâ

After successful verification, your domain or subdomain will appear in the Verified Domains list. Select the desired domain from the list and click Deploy

Your application will now be live and accessible via your chosen URL.

5. Frequently Asked Questionsâ

Can I buy a domain through Abacus?â

Yes, you can search for and purchase domains directly on Abacus and use them to publish your apps. Learn more about purchasing domains here.

What is the pricing for hosting my website on my own domain ?â

There is no extra cost, itâs included in your monthly subscription.

How long does it take for the domain/subdomain to get verified?â

It usually takes between 5 minutes to 48 hours from the time you update the DNS records for a domain / subdomain to get verified and be available for you to deploy.

What Does Verification Status Mean?â

The verification status tells you whether your domain or subdomain has been successfully verified with Abacus.AI. This status must be "Verified" before you can deploy your app.

Here is what each status means:

  • Verified: Your domain or subdomain has been successfully verified and is ready for deployment.
  • Pending: Your domain registration was not completed successfully. Please re-try the domain registration process.
  • In Progress: Ensure your DNS records are updated. If they're already set, verification is underway and should complete within 24 hours.
  • Failed: The verification attempt was unsuccessful. You may need to double-check your DNS settings and try the verification again.

Managing and Updating Other DNS Records for subdomainsâ

Updating A records, MX records, AAAA records, or any other DNS records

Case 1 - Domain Verification using Nameserversâ

If your domain was verified using nameserver records, you can update other DNS records on Abacus.AI:

  1. Open Manage domains
  2. Click on the settings button next to the desired domain
  3. Select the desired type in the "type" dropdown and update the required values
Case 2 - Domain Verification using CNAMEâ

If your domain was verified using CNAME records, you can update A records, MX records, AAAA records, or any other DNS records directly through your domain registrar or domain provider's website.

How to verify my domain if my domain provider does not provide CNames records for my domain?â

There are two options:

Option 1: Utilize Our Nameserversâ

This approach involves using our nameservers.

To proceed with this option, please follow these instructions:

  1. Delete your previously added domain (if you had added) from Abacus.AI and clear any DNS records that may have been added during the configuration process at your domain provider.
  2. Re-add your domain in Abacus.AI. After entering the domain name, you will be provided with two nameservers.
  3. Add the two provided nameservers to your domain provider and allow time for your domain to be verified.
  4. (Optional) Once verified, if you need to add any other records (e.g., email-related DNS records), click on the gear icon within the "Manage Domains" pop-up in Abacus.AI.
Option 2: Configure a Subdomainâ

This option allows you to configure a subdomain of yourdomain.com (e.g., app.yourdomain.com) using CNAME records and deploy your application on that subdomain.

To proceed with this option, please follow these instructions:

  1. Delete your previously added yourdomain.com domain from Abacus.AI and clear any DNS records that may have been added during the configuration process.
  2. Add your new subdomain. Enter the subdomain of your choice (e.g., app.yourdomain.com) and continue with the setup steps.

Do you support domain verification using A records?â

No, we don't support domain verification using A-records.

We currently support two methods to verify custom domains. You can verify your domain/subdomain using CNames or Nameservers(NS) records based on your domain provider.

How to unlink a domain/ Subdomain?â

To unlink domain / subdomain:

  1. Open the Manage domains
  2. Click on the "Unlink" button in the Actions column

Billing

How much is the ChatLLM subscription?â

A ChatLLM subscription is $10 per user per month. You will be billed $10 when you sign up. You can cancel anytime, and your subscription will stay active for the month.

You can also upgrade to the Pro tier for an additional $10 a month. The Pro tier gives you more unrestricted access to our more powerful Abacus AI Deep Agent.Â  You can use Abacus AI Deep Agent for however many tasks you like, as long as you have active credits in the account.


What is the difference between the Basic and Pro tier?â

A basic ChatLLM subscription costs $10/month and provides access to all ChatLLM features, 20k credits, and limited access to Abacus AI Deep Agent (3 tasks of limited complexity). Since video generation is expensive, short videos are not available in the basic tier.

Upgrading to Pro costs an additional $10/month, gives you 5k extra credits, and allows you to use Abacus AI Deep Agent without restriction, provided you have the credits to do so. If you plan to use Abacus AI Deep Agent for creating apps, we recommend upgrading to the Pro tier.


What is the Pro tier and what advantages does it give me?â

The Pro tier costs an additional $10 monthly and gives you unrestricted access to Abacus AI Deep Agent. You can use all of your active credits on Abacus AI Deep Agent tasks.

The Pro tier also uses a much more powerful version of Abacus AI Deep Agent. This means your tasks will yield better and richer results.

Finally, the Pro Tier gives you an additional 5000 credits. Please read about credits below.


What are the usage limits on the LLMs?â

Our LLM usage limits are more generous than other paid services. On SOTA LLMs like GPT-5.2, Sonnet-4.5, or Gemini 3, you can send thousands of messages without attachments without hitting a usage limit.

We give you 20K credits every month. These credits can be used for various operations, including sending messages to the top LLMs, creating videos and images, and generating documents.

PLEASE NOTE - these credits are NOT TOKENS, and you can get up to 15M input tokens for some expensive models like Sonnet-4.5 and GPT-5.2 with these credits and 70M tokens on others.

In addition, you can use the RouteLLM, GPT-5 Mini, Gemini 3 Flash, Grok Code Fast, GLM 4.7, Kimi K2, and Llama4 models without ANY LIMITS.

If you choose to use credits for video, audio, or document generation, we will deduct credits proportional to the current market rate of those services. Typically, this translates to around 500 images, 40 5-second videos, or 25 Abacus AI Deep Agent tasks in a month from a premium service. KlingAI is extremely expensive; you will get very few videos if you use this service.

Our SOTA image models include GPT Image 1.5, Nano Banana Pro, FLUX.2, Flux Kontext, Seedream, Recraft, and Ideogram. For high-quality image generation, we recommend Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 1.5. For video generation, our SOTA video models include Sora 2, KlingAI, Wan, Lumalabs, Hailuo, and RunwayML. These models are compute-intensive and may consume more credits per task.


What models can I use on an unlimited basis?â

You can use the GPT-5 Mini, Gemini 3 Flash, Grok Code Fast, GLM 4.7, Kimi K2, and Llama4 on an unlimited basis.

Typically, any new model from the Llama, Gemini Flash, and GPT Mini families will be offered on an unlimited basis.

Itâs important to note that these will still accrue credits on an ongoing basis, but you will be able to continue using them even after hitting the credit limit.


Where can I see the credits?â

You can always see credits on your profile's billing page. For a detailed log on your usage, click 'View Credit Usage' on your profile. We also show credits against each message if you are using them up quickly. If you want to always view the credits used for each message, you can do so by activating the toggle on your profile.


Do my purchased credits disappear if I donât use them within the month?â

No, your purchased credits roll over to the following month if unused.

Please note that this is separate from the monthly 20K credits that come with your subscription â these reset to 20K on your renewal date.


How much does it cost to host apps on Abacus AI?â

Abacus.AI provides a generous free tier for database, file hosting, and app server management (up to 25,000 credits per month) until your app starts receiving significant traffic. Beyond that, charges apply. For more detailed information, click here.


Why don't you have exact credits published per model?â

Credits are just a measure of the usage of our entire service. This includes our AI engineer, AI Workflows, LLMs, Video Generators, and Image Generators. We constantly add new models, change model rates, and make the product more efficient. This is why you can only see credits after usage. That said, we are very generous concerning our rate limits, and you can always monitor your credits on the billing page. We will show it for every generation or message when we think you are using too many.

Some models, such as o3-pro and Claude Opus 4.5, are more compute-intensive and may consume more credits per task. This is why we recommend monitoring your credit usage on the billing page.


What is this 75% usage message Iâm receiving?â

The limit exists because the 10K credits cost $10, and we give you a generous amount of 20K credits every month, but the idea is to spread it for the entire month. If you want to spend more credits, you can always buy more.

You can use the last 25% on the last week of your subscription


How does the API work?â

API usage is billed the same way as everything else. The more API calls you make the more credits you will consume. Credit consumption will be based on the price of the LLM used. These prices are some of the cheapest on the planet and are listed directly in the RouteLLM API page available here.

API usage can be seen on the Credit Usage Log by checking "Group by Source". This records API usage on a daily basis. A more detailed breakdown of RouteLLM API usage will be available shortly.


How many users can I invite?â

There is no limit to the number of users you can invite! You will be billed on a monthly basis based on the size of your team. In addition, you will be billed immediately for every additional user you invite at a rate of $10/user/month.


If I get invited to a team, do I have to pay?â

No, the owner of the team organization will get the invoice for your membership on that team. If you are being prompted to pay, you likely need to switch organizations so you are on the team organization and not your own organization.


How can I view my past payments?â

You can view all past payments by going to your profile and navigating to the Billing and Invoices page. There, you will be able to see your payment details and history. You will also be able to download past invoices and update your payment information.


How can I change my billing/invoice information?â

Click on your Profile at the top right, then click on Profile & Billing. Click on Billing Details, then Update Address. Similarly, on the Billing Details page, you can also update your Card information.


How can I cancel my subscription?â

You can cancel anytime from the Abacus.AI ChatLLM interface. Billing subscription details are available on the desktop interface by clicking on your name or organization in the top right corner and on Profile. âCancel Subscriptionâ should be located at the bottom right of the page.


How do I delete my credit card from my account?â

To delete your credit card, you need to delete your accountâemail support@abacus.ai for assistance.


How do I delete my account?â

In order to delete your account, please contact us at support@abacus.ai and we will handle it for you.


I would like to access certain Enterprise features. What is the price point of the enterprise plan?â

The starting price point for Abacus.AI Enterprise is $5000. If you are interested, email support@abacus.ai or sales@abacus.ai to be properly connected to the right person.


Thereâs been a mistake in my billing. How do I get this fixed?â

If you think your billing is incorrect, email support@abacus.ai and someone will investigate.


What are the limitations for the commercial use of images generated using the Abacus.AI platform?â

There are no restrictions or limitations. No one owns the rights of AI generated images, so you can use them freely across any sector.


My AI model, AI Workflow, or Abacus AI Deep Agent isn't doing exactly what I want. Can I get a refund?â

Our AI models and Abacus AI Deep Agent are provided as-is. Their behavior is influenced by how they are prompted, the nature of the tasks you're asking them to perform, and the complexity involved. While we continuously work to enhance their capabilities, we can't guarantee perfect performance for every prompt or scenario.

We recommend that you simplify or clarify your instructions. You can check out our Prompting Tips and Tricks. Even small adjustments to your prompt or task complexity can lead to significantly better outcomes.

Keep in mind that some tasks may be too complex for an AIâor even a humanâto complete in just a few minutes.

As with most AI services, we do not offer refunds based on the model's output or performance.

Building Chabots and AI Workflows

Источник: https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/faqs/chatbots-vs-workflows

  • FAQS
  • Chatbots Versus AI Workflows

Building Chabots and AI Workflows

Abacus.AI provides two ways to create Custom Chatbots and AI Workflows (AI Agents):

  • Developer Platform: Build through our developer platform.
  • Prompting Abacus AI Deep Agent: Use Abacus AI Deep Agent in ChatLLM Teams / Super Assistant.

Chatbots: Simplifying Conversations with Customizationâ

Chatbots are fabricated to handle conversational tasks, making them ideal for customer support, product recommendations, or internal team assistance. With the AI Engineer, you can create chatbots that are tailored to your specific needs, integrating contextual data and delivering precise responses.
Example: Healthcare Engagement Chatbot:
A chatbot can be created to assist with patient engagement in healthcare settings. A chatbot will:

  • Collect input about clinic services, patient demographics and engagement goals.
  • Generate a detailed plan for improving patient satisfaction and follow-up compliance.
  • Provide personalized content, such as educational materials, secure messaging options and follow-up reminders.

This type of chatbot is perfect for healthcare providers looking to improve communication and engagement with their patients. It demonstrates how chatbots can be customized to handle specific workflows and deliver meaningful results.

AI Workflows: Tackling Complex Operationsâ

For tasks that go beyond simple conversations, AI Agents are the way to go. These agents are designed to perform advanced operations, such as automating workflows, extracting information from documents or even integrating with external systems like Salesforce.

Example: Salesforce Agent Deployment
An AI Workflow can be created to automate the creation of new opportunities in Salesforce. For example:

  • The user submits a request to create a new opportunity.
  • A form appears, prompting the user to fill in fields such as "Title," "Amount," "Close Date," and "Stage Name."
  • Once submitted, the agent processes the input and creates a new opportunity in Salesforce.
  • The newly created opportunity is displayed in the Salesforce Console, complete with all relevant details.

This type of agent is ideal for sales teams, as it streamlines the process of managing opportunities, reduces manual data entry, and ensures accuracy in the CRM system.

Example: Customer Account Agent
Another example of an AI Workflow is one designed to assist with customer account management. This agent will:

  • Extract key details from customer inquiries or attached documents.
  • Automate responses to common account-related questions, such as billing or subscription status.
  • Update account information or send reminders based on user input.

AI Workflows are best suited for tasks that require multi-step processes, such as document processing, workflow automation, or integrating with external systems.

Chatbots vs. Agents: Choosing The Right Tool For Youâ

When deciding between a chatbot and an AI agent, consider the complexity of your task:

FeatureChatbotsAI Agents
Use CaseConversational tasks, FAQs, recommendationsComplex operations, document processing, workflow automation
CustomizationHigh, with options for contextual data integrationHigh, with advanced capabilities for multi-step processes
Setup TimeQuick and easyRequires more input but offers greater flexibility

Chatbots are ideal for conversational engagement, while AI agents are better suited for handling complex workflows and automating multi-step processes.

ChatLLM Tasks

The ChatLLM Tasks feature is designed to help you automate and manage a variety of tasks seamlessly. If you need help with queries like "fetch stock market data every day at 9 AM" or "receive a workout plan every Monday and Wednesday for 3 months," ChatLLM Tasks can assist in organizing your schedule and ensuring you never miss a beat.

How do I create and manage ChatLLM Tasks?â

To get started with ChatLLM Tasks:

  • Select Task Option: Navigate to the 'Task' option from the tools in the 'more' section near the search bar. This is your gateway to creating new tasks.
  • Create a Task: Once you've selected the 'Task' option, you can use natural language to describe the task you want to automate.
  • Tasks execution: Once you've created a task, a new conversation will be created with the task name. You can find all the runs of a task in that conversation.
  • Manage Your Tasks: After creating tasks, you can view a detailed list of all your tasks in the 'Tasks' section under the tools menu. This section helps you monitor and manage your tasks efficiently.

Capabilities of ChatLLM Tasksâ

With ChatLLM Tasks, you have the flexibility to:

  • Create Tasks: Set up new tasks tailored to your needs.
  • Pause and Resume Tasks: Temporarily halt tasks and restart them as required.
  • Edit Tasks: Modify existing tasks to better suit your changing requirements.
  • Delete Tasks: Remove tasks that are no longer needed.
  • Create Email Alerts: Get email alerts for task runs.

These capabilities ensure that you have full control over your task management, allowing you to optimize your workflow.

Example Prompts for ChatLLM Tasksâ

Here are some example prompts to help you get started with ChatLLM Tasks:

  • "Fetch stock market data every day at 9 AM and alert me through email."
  • "Send me a weather update next Saturday at 9 AM."
  • "Generate a workout plan for me every Monday and Wednesday for the next 3 months."
  • "Send me updates on new AI breakthroughs every month."

These prompts can be used as a starting point to create your own customized tasks and automate your daily routines effectively.

Important Considerationsâ

While ChatLLM Tasks offers powerful automation, it's important to be mindful of the following:

  • Credit Consumption: Having a large number of tasks can consume your 'credits.' It's advisable to monitor your task list to avoid excessive usage.
  • Rate Limitations: The number of tasks and their frequency is subject to rate limits. This is designed to ensure that credits are not depleted rapidly, allowing for sustainable task management.

By understanding these considerations, you can make the most of ChatLLM Tasks while managing your resources efficiently.

General

What is chatllm and what are its benefits?â

ChatLLM is the world's first AI super-assistant. You get access to all the state-of-the-art LLMs including GPT-5.2, GPT-5.2 Thinking, GPT-Image, Sonnet-4.5, Opus 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro, Grok 4.1, Qwen 3 and Llama 4. We will also add any new state-of-the-art LLM that is launched as soon as possible to the product. You can query the web, generate images, execute code, chat with PDFs, humanize your text, analyze charts, create custom chatbots and AI Workflows, access our playground feature and much more.

With ChatLLM you can also connect all your internal systems including GDrive, Slack and Confluence and set up custom chatbots and AI Agents on your data.

Who is Chatllm designed for?â

ChatLLM is best for professionals, students and small teams. You can invite everyone on your team and share chats and manage your subscription

What abilities do your chatbots have?â

Our built-in chatbots can perform a large variety of tasks automatically for you based on your input and conversations. They can:

  • Document Analysis: Analyze, summarize, and discuss uploaded documents (PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, images, etc.).
  • Data Analysis: Perform data analysis and generate charts from uploaded CSVs and Excel files.
  • Image Generation: Generate pictures using top SOTA models like GPT Image 1.5, Nano Banana Pro, FLUX.2, Recraft, Imagen, and Ideogram. GPT Image 1.5 produces exceptionally high-quality images you can use in your collateral and other media.
  • Video Generation: Generate videos using top SOTA models like Sora 2, KlingAI, Veo-3, Lumalabs, Hailuo, and RunwayML.
  • Text Humanization: Humanize responses with Professional, Humorous, and Caring tone options.
  • iPhone and Android apps: We offer both Android and iOS apps. This means that you can use Abacus via your mobile, tablet, iPhone, and iPad device without issues! Both apps have all the state-of-the-art abilities, including voice.
  • Custom Instructions: Apply instructions to all chats to give the bot information about yourself and your goals.
  • Code Playground: Generate and run code for self-contained applications, displaying the results alongside your chat.
  • Web Search: Search the web and get up-to-date information on any topic.
  • AI Engineer: Use the AI engineer to create custom chatbots and AI agents. You tell the AI engineer what to do, and it can build applications.
  • Slack, Teams, and Other Integrations: You can integrate with many enterprise systems, including Slack, Teams, Confluence, G-Drive, GCal, Gmail, etc.

Can I integrate ChatLLM with other tools and platforms?â

Yes, ChatLLM offers integrations with various tools and platforms. You can connect ChatLLM to communication platforms like Slack and Microsoft Teams, as well as integrate with other APIs and services to enhance your workflow. Check our integration guide for detailed instructions on setting up these connections.

How often are new LLMs added to ChatLLM?â

We strive to stay at the forefront of AI advancements. ChatLLM continuously monitors developments in the AI field and aims to integrate the latest LLMs as soon as they become available. Our goal is to provide you with the latest and most effective tools for your needs.

Can I customize the AI agents created with ChatLLM?â

Yes, ChatLLM allows you to customize AI agents to suit your specific requirements. You can configure settings, define behaviors, and set instructions to tailor the AI agents to your needs. This flexibility ensures that the agents align with your objectives and preferences.

How can I use ChatLLM for Python code execution?â

ChatLLM allows you to generate and execute Python code directly within the platform. Simply input your code prompt or request, and ChatLLM will provide you with the code and an option to execute it. This feature helps you quickly test and run Python scripts without leaving the platform.

What types of Python code can ChatLLM handle?â

ChatLLM can handle a wide range of Python code, including data analysis, machine learning models, web scraping, automation scripts, and more. Whether you need a simple function or a complex script, ChatLLM can assist in generating and executing the code.

How do I execute Python code using ChatLLM?â

To execute Python code with ChatLLM, follow these steps:

  • Provide a clear prompt for the code you need.
  • Review the generated code snippet.
  • Click on the "Execute" button next to the code snippet.
  • View the results directly within the platform.

Can I save and reuse Python code snippets generated by ChatLLM?â

Yes, you can save Python code snippets generated by ChatLLM for future use. You can copy the code to your local environment or save it within the platform for easy access and reuse.

How to Share ChatLLM Projectsâ

To share ChatLLM projects (projects visible in the ChatLLM UI, not on the development platform), follow these steps:

  1. Make sure the other users are added to your organization: Go to Profile â Team and invite them to the correct org.
  2. Open the ChatLLM project you want to share, click Edit, and then add the users you want to share the project with.

How to Purchase / Buy More Creditsâ

If you have run out of credits, you can purchase more by following these steps:

  1. Click on the profile icon in the top right corner of the interface.
  2. Navigate to Profile â Profile & Billing.
  3. Click on the "Buy Credits" button.

Pro Tip: If youâve used all 3 Abacus AI Deep Agent conversations (chats) included in the Basic plan, consider upgrading to the Pro tier. Pro removes this limit so you can start as many Abacus AI Deep Agent conversations as you need, as long as you have credits available!

What is the Best Large Language Model (LLM)â

Playground

Code playground FAQsâ

What is the ChatLLM Code playground feature?â

The ChatLLM Code playground is a feature within the ChatLLM platform that allows users to initialize and experiment with different artifacts, such as prompts, models, and entire conversations. It provides a sandbox environment for users to test and refine their ideas.

How do I access the ChatLLM Code playground feature?â

To access the ChatLLM Code playground feature, follow these steps:

Navigate to the ChatLLM Website: Open a web browser and go to the ChatLLM website.

  • Log In or Sign Up: If you haven't already, create a ChatLLM account by clicking on the "Sign Up" button. If you have an account, click on the "Log In" button and enter your credentials.

  • Choose the LLM: Once logged in, choose the LLM you want to use in the top navigation bar. Chat LLM offers various top LLMs including GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 3, Abacus Smaug, and more. Click on the LLM to access it.

  • Write the Prompt and Access Code playground: Next, give the LLM the prompt for the artifact you need. The output will include the option âShow Code playground.â You can click on it to access the Code Playground feature.

What kind of artifacts can I create in the ChatLLM Code playground?â

The ChatLLM Code playground allows users to create a variety of artifacts, including but not limited to:

  • Custom prompts for AI models
  • Conversational scenarios
  • Model configurations
  • Entire conversations
  • Games
  • And more

Can I save my artifacts in the Code playground?â

Yes, the ChatLLM Code playground allows you to save your artifacts for future reference or to share with others. This feature is particularly useful for collaborative projects or for tracking your progress over time.

Can I use the Code playground to test different AI models?â

Yes, the ChatLLM Code playground supports testing and comparing different AI models. You can experiment with various models, including fine-tuned models like myself, to see how they respond to different prompts and scenarios.

Can I get help if I encounter issues in the Code playground?â

Yes, ChatLLM provides documentation and support resources to help you with any issues you might encounter while using the Code playground feature. You can also reach out to the ChatLLM community or support team for assistance.

Can I use the Code playground for commercial purposes?â

The terms of use for the ChatLLM Code playground feature, including commercial use, are outlined in the ChatLLM terms of service. Be sure to review these terms before using the feature for any commercial applications.

What kinds of prompts can activate the Code playground feature?â

You can use various prompts to activate the Code playground feature. Here are some examples:

  • Example 1: Prompt: "Create an SVG of a bouncing ball."

    • Follow-up: "Can you create a game where the ball has to avoid obstacles while bouncing?"

  • Example 2: Prompt: "Create an SVG of a spaceship."

    • Follow-up: "Can you make a game where I can navigate the spaceship through an asteroid field?"

  • Example 3: Prompt: "Design a simple blog page with a sidebar and main content area."

    • Follow-up: "Can you also include a comment section under each blog post?"

  • Example 4: Prompt: "Develop a drawing app where users can create and save their sketches."

  • Example 5: Prompt: "Make a simple to-do list app where users can add and check off tasks."

    • Follow-up: "Can you include a feature to set reminders for each task?"

These prompts help illustrate the type of interactive tasks the Code playground feature can handle.

Referrals

Referrals

What is the referral program all about?â

Referral program provides an opportunity to earn money by inviting friends and family to Chatllm Teams. You earn $5 for each new user who signs up using your unique referral URL.

What is the difference between referring someone and inviting someone?â

When you invite someone to your team, they become part of your organization. You can share any chatllm applications you build, control their access and even share chats among team members in the organization. Additionally, the admin will be responsible for the organization's billing which is determined by the number of members in the organization.

On the other hand, referring someone means that the referred individual will have to create their own account and will not be part of your organization. You and the referred user will operate as two separate entities, completely independent from each other.

Will I earn money if I invite someone to my team?â

Unlike referrals, no money will be earned if you invite someone into your organization.

How do I refer someone?â

Please use your unique referral URL available at https://apps.abacus.ai/chatllm/admin/referrals/ to refer friends. You can also enter their email address and we will send them an invite with your unique referral URL.

When and how do I get paid?â

You get paid $5 when a new user signs up using your referral URL, and you can choose to receive your payment through either Paypal or Stripe. You can track all your referrals at https://apps.abacus.ai/chatllm/admin/referrals/.

Why is my cashout option grayed out?â

Your cashout option will be grayed out if you have 0 available balance.

What do the different referral statuses mean?â

Your referral payments might have the following statuses:

Available: This status indicates that your referral has signed up and the money is available for cashout.

Redeeming: This state indicates that you have requested a cash out of your available balance but the payment is not yet completed. It shouldn't be in this state for more than a few hours.

Redeemed: This indicates that you have successfully cashed out the referral credit.

How much will I earn if I refer a new user who invites more people to their organization?â

You will earn $5 for each new user you refer, regardless of the number of people they subsequently invite to their organization.

Is there a limit on the number of users I can refer?â

No, there is no limit on the number of users you can refer.

Abacus.AI Super Assistant, also known as ChatLLM Teams, is an all-in-one AI platform that provides access to the world's top Large Language Models (LLMs) from both open-source and proprietary domains. It's designed as a comprehensive AI assistant for professionals, students, and teams.

What Makes it Specialâ

ChatLLM Teams consolidates multiple AI capabilities into a single, unified interface, eliminating the need to juggle between different specialized tools. As Abacus.AI describes it, it's "one AI assistant with access to all top LLMs, video and image generators" with general purpose and coding agents included.

Multimodal AI Featuresâ

  • Generate presentations (PowerPoint and Word documents)
  • Search the web with real-time information
  • Create and analyze documents (PDF, DOCX, CSV)
  • Generate images using FLUX-1 Pro, DALLÂ·E, Ideogram, and Recraft
  • Generate videos from text using KlingAI, Lumalabs, Hailuo, and RunwayML
  • Code generation and editing with GitHub integration
  • Execute code, analyze data, and draw plots
  • Text-to-speech and voice mode capabilities

Why Choose ChatLLM Teams?â

Instead of paying for and managing multiple AI subscriptions (ChatGPT for text, Midjourney for images, Runway for video, GitHub Copilot for code), ChatLLM Teams provides all these capabilities in one platform. As noted by Indie Boosting, it offers "features such as image and video generation, PowerPoint and Word document creation, PDF analysis, and advanced developer tools including code auto-completion and GitHub integration."

The platform is designed to be more powerful and accessible than ChatGPT alone, offering generous usage limits that allow thousands of messages per month on top-tier models without hitting quotas.

MCP Servers How-to

Источник: https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/mcp-servers

  • MCP Servers How-to

MCP Servers How-to

Deep Agent MCPs: Superpowers for Your God-Tier Agentâ

Deep Agent now supports Model Context Protocols (MCPs), enabling seamless integration with external tools and data sources. MCP standardizes how AI agents interact with resources, making it easier to enhance Deep Agent's capabilities with real-time data, APIs, and services. This guide walks you through setting up and using MCPs in Deep Agent to create powerful, context-aware AI workflows.

What Are MCPs?â

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that connects AI models, like those in Deep Agent, to external systems via a client-server architecture. Think of MCP as a universal connector, allowing Deep Agent to access tools (such as GitHub or databases) and resources (like files or APIs) without custom integrations. With MCP, you can enable Deep Agent to perform tasks like querying databases, fetching web content, or automating workflows.

Prerequisitesâ

Youâll need:

  • A Deep Agent account with access to the platform.
  • API keys or credentials for external tools you want to integrate (for example, GitHub or Notion).
  • Access to an MCP server (community-built or custom) or the ability to set one up.

Note: You can find a list of community-built MCP servers at GitHub and mcp.so. These directories will guide you on how to obtain the necessary tokens or API keys to configure your servers. Pick your favorite MCPs from these platforms and get started quickly.

Step-by-Step Guide to Using MCPs in Deep Agentâ

Step 1: Go to MCP Settings Config Pageâ

  1. Log in to your Abacus.AI account and navigate to the Deep Agent Homepage.

  2. Click the Configure MCP button.

  3. Alternatively, go to the Deep Agent Settings page via the top-right corner menu, then select MCP Server Config from the sidebar.

Step 2: Install and Configure an MCP Serverâ
  1. Choose an MCP server that suits your needs (for example, create a repository in GitHub or fetch content from the web). Both local servers (installable via npm or PyPI) and remote servers (already deployed) are supported.
  2. Servers requiring access to your local filesystem will not work, as MCP servers run in an isolated environment without local filesystem access.
  3. Copy the serverâs config JSON and paste it into the JSON Config settings page.
  4. Add a new MCP server config JSON based on its transport type:
    • Stdio: For local servers, provide the required parameters such as command, args, env, etc. Example: 
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-github"]
    • SSE: For remote servers, provide the server URL and other optional parameters. Example: http://example.com:8000/sse
  5. Configure the server with necessary credentials or environment variables (such as API keys), and make sure you are authenticated on the remote server platform when using remote servers.
  6. Deep Agent will query the server to list available tools and resources.
Example Configâ

Below is a sample JSON configuration for two MCP servers: GitHub and Google Tasks.

{
  "github": {
    "command": "npx",
    "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-github"],
    "env": {
      "GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN": "<YOUR_TOKEN>"
    }
  },
  "google_tasks": {
    "url": "<REMOTE_SERVER_URL>"
  }
}
Step 3: Use MCP Tools in Deep Agentâ
  1. In your Deep Agent chat interface, instruct the agent to use the MCP tool. For example: "Access this website and tell me its structure using Playwrightâs tools."
  2. Deep Agent will display a call to the tool with the requested parameters.
  3. View the tool's output in the chat, which Deep Agent can use for further tasks (such as summarizing content).

FAQs and Troubleshootingâ

Why isn't my MCP server connecting?â

  • Ensure that the command or URL in your config JSON is correct and matches the format shown in the example config. Also, verify that the server is running.

  • Some platforms may wrap the JSON config within a structure like the one below. When copying the config, include only the server configuration JSONânot the wrapper. Refer to the example config above.

    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "<your server config json>"
      }
    }

Can I use multiple MCP servers?â

Yes, Deep Agent supports adding up to 5 servers and up to 50 tools across those servers. Add each server in the Integrations settings, but limit active tools to avoid overwhelming the LLM.

How do I secure my MCP connections?â

Use MCP servers from trusted sources only, and prefer OAuth authentication for remote servers.

Connect HubSpot MCP with Abacus AI Abacus AI Deep Agent

Overviewâ

Abacus AI is an all-in-one AI platform and a general-purpose agent powered by Abacus AI Deep Agent. With the official HubSpot MCP server, you can securely connect your HubSpot account to Abacus AI and enable intelligent analysis, workflows, chatbots, and automated actions on top of your CRM data â all with read-only permissions for complete safety.

Install the appâ

You can connect HubSpot to Abacus AI in two ways â either directly through a natural-language query inside Abacus AI Deep Agent, or by connecting from the MCP Server configuration page.

Option 1: Connect directly through a queryâ

  1. Log in to your Abacus AI Home.
  2. Open the Abacus AI Deep Agent interface and type a query that mentions HubSpot, for example:
    • âRead my recent HubSpot deals.â
  3. Abacus AI will detect HubSpot is required and show a Sign in with HubSpot button.
  4. Click the button to begin the OAuth authentication flow.
  5. Select the HubSpot account you want to connect.
  6. Review the requested scopes (Abacus AI requests read-only permissions to CRM objects and properties).
  7. Click Connect app.
  8. After authentication you will be redirected back to Abacus AI. The HubSpot MCP Sign in button will appear as Authenticated and the task will continue automatically.

Option 2: Connect via MCP Server Configurationâ

  1. Log in to Abacus AI.
  2. Open Profile â Connectors â MCP Servers â Ask AI.
  3. Search for HubSpot in the list of available MCP servers.
  4. Click Connect next to HubSpot.
  5. Complete the OAuth sign-in process following the HubSpot prompts.
  6. Once authenticated, HubSpot will appear in your list of active servers.

Configure the appâ

No additional manual setup is required after connecting. The HubSpot MCP server immediately enables Abacus AI to read any CRM objects and properties allowed by the OAuth scopes you approved.

Using this connection Abacus AI can:

  • Read CRM object records (contacts, companies, deals, tickets, etc.).
  • Summarize or analyze CRM datasets.
  • Build automated workflows using Abacus AI Deep Agent.
  • Power chatbots that use HubSpot data via MCP actions.
  • Generate dashboards, insights, or reports based on CRM data.

Important: All data access is read-only â Abacus AI does not modify HubSpot data.

Use the appâ

Once connected, you can use HubSpot within Abacus AI immediately.

1. Natural-language queriesâ

Ask Abacus AI Deep Agent examples such as:

  • âSummarize my latest HubSpot contacts.â
  • âShow me deals created last week.â
  • âCreate a report of companies grouped by lifecycle stage.â

2. Automated workflowsâ

Use Abacus AI Deep Agent to build workflows that:

  • Pull CRM data from HubSpot.
  • Analyze or summarize that data.
  • Trigger agent actions (e.g., generate reports, send notifications).
  • Schedule periodic insights or reports.

3. Chatbots / AI appsâ

Create chatbots or AI apps that continuously read HubSpot data using MCP actions. Useful scenarios include:

  • Customer support automation.
  • Analytics assistants for sales teams.
  • Sales enablement bots that surface CRM insights on demand.

Disconnect the appâ

To remove the HubSpot connection from Abacus AI:

  1. Go to Profile â MCP Servers inside Abacus AI.
  2. Locate the connected HubSpot server.
  3. Click Delete or Disconnect.
  4. Confirm the action.

The HubSpot integration will be removed immediately and Abacus AI will stop accessing your HubSpot data.

Data handling after disconnectingâ

  • Abacus AI does not store HubSpot data.
  • Abacus AI does not modify any HubSpot records (read-only access).
  • After disconnecting, no further data is accessed.
  • Your HubSpot CRM remains unchanged and safe.

Uninstall the appâ

If you want to uninstall the integration completely from HubSpot, follow HubSpotâs official uninstall steps:

  1. In HubSpot, go to Settings â Connected Apps.
  2. Find Abacus AI in the list.
  3. Click Uninstall and follow prompts.

Prompting Tips and Tricks

Источник: https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/prompting-tips-and-tricks

  • Prompting Tips and Tricks

Prompting Tips and Tricks

Here are some general tips for effective prompting with ChatLLM:

  • Be Clear and Specific: Clearly specify what you want in your prompt. The more detailed your request, the better the response.

    • Example: Generate a detailed summary of the latest trends in AI technology.

  • Use Simple Language: Avoid using overly complex language. Keep your prompts straightforward to ensure the AI understands.

    • Example: Explain the concept of blockchain in simple terms.

  • Provide Context: Give enough context in your prompts to help the AI generate accurate responses.

    • Example: Write a marketing email for a new fitness app targeting young professionals.

  • Iterate and Refine: If the response isn't what you expected, try refining your original question or providing more details.

    • Example: Summarize the benefits of renewable energy. Focus on solar and wind power.

  • Ask for Examples: When in doubt, ask the AI to provide examples to clarify its response.

    • Example: Give me examples of how to write an engaging LinkedIn post.

  • Break Down Complex Tasks: For complex requests, break them down into smaller, manageable steps.

    • Example: First, generate an outline for a research paper on climate change. Then, write an introduction based on the outline.

  • Text Generation: To get a well-written article or blog post, be specific about the topic and desired length.

    • Example: Write a 500-word blog post about the benefits of remote work.

  • Image Generation: For generating images, clearly describe the scene or object you want.

    • Example: Create an image of a serene beach with palm trees and a sunset in the background.

  • Web Search: To trigger a web search, use words like recent, latest etc. The more explicit you are the better

    • Example: Find the latest news on electric vehicles.

  • Code Generation: For coding, mention the programming language and the task you need.

    • Example: Write a Python script to fetch weather data from an API.

  • Data Analysis: For data analysis, upload your data and ask specific questions about it.

    • Example: Analyze this sales data and provide insights on monthly trends.

  • Playground: In the playground, you can experiment with different commands to see how ChatLLM responds.

    • Example: Design a portfolio website with sections for projects, skills, and contact information.

  • ChatLLM Operator: ChatLLM Operator can provides you assistance with various computer related tasks.

    • Example: Check the current system resources usage

  • ChatLLM Tasks: ChatLLM can assist with a variety of tasks. Be clear about what you need help with.

    • Example: Fetch stock market data every day at 9 AM

Learn more about how to work with playgrounds. Still have questions regarding the playground features? Check Playground FAQs here : Playground FAQs

Still have questions regarding the ChatLLM Tasks feature? Check ChatLLM Tasks FAQs here : ChatLLM Tasks FAQs

By following these tips, you can make the most out of ChatLLM's powerful capabilities. Happy prompting!

Purchase Domain

You can now purchase domains directly through Abacus.AI â making it a quick and hassle-free process to deploy your apps on custom URLs.

Domain Purchasing lets you search, buy, and publish your Abacus.AI Apps on purchased domains directly within the platform hassle free.

Featuresâ

Domain Purchasing streamlines the process of giving your apps professional custom URLs. Instead of juggling multiple services, you can complete your entire web presence setup within Abacus.AI.

  • Domain search and availability: Check availability across popular extensions like .com, .ai, and more
  • One-click purchasing: Buy domains directly through Abacus.AI using your credits
  • Automatic configuration: Domains are auto-verified without manual DNS setup
  • WHOIS privacy protection: Your personal information stays private in public domain records, included by default with every domain purchase
  • Custom DNS records: Add custom A, TXT, and MX records to configure email providers and other services
  • Automatic renewals: Domains renew automatically so your apps stay published without interruption

How to Purchase a Domainâ

  1. Click the Deploy button on your appâs conversation
  2. Select the Custom Domains tab and choose Purchase Domain
  3. Search for a domain and pick one from the available results
  4. Complete the purchase â Abacus deducts credits from your balance
  5. The purchased domain is automatically configured and enters verification (may take some time)
  6. Once verified, your domain becomes available for app deployment with no additional setup

You will be billed for the domain purchase through your Abacus credits balance.

Renewals & Transfersâ

Automatic Renewalsâ

  • Domains renew automatically each year to keep your apps accessible
  • To disable automatic renewals, contact support@abacus.ai

Transfer Supportâ

If you want to transfer domain ownership to someone else, eplease feel free to write to us at support@abacus.ai with the details and we will facilitate the transfer.

Configuring Subdomainsâ

If you wish to use a subdomain of a domain purchased through Abacus.AI:

  1. Please confirm the verification status of the domain - The domain must be verified with Abacus. If the verification is in pending state, please wait till it is verified.
  2. Once the domain is verified with Abacus, you can click on Add new domain and type the subdomain of your choice.
  3. Abacus will automatically create the required DNS records, and the subdomain will enter the verification process.
  4. After the subdomain is successfully verified, you can deploy your website on that specific subdomain.

Custom DNS Recordsâ

For domains purchased through Abacus, you can add custom DNS records to configure additional services like email providers. Supported DNS record types:

  • A records: Point your domain/subdomain to an IP address
  • CNAME records: To point your domain to another domain name, you can create an alias for your domain or subdomain. This can be used for redirecting multiple domain names to a single canonical domain.
  • TXT records: Add text-based verification records for services like email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).
  • MX records: MX (Mail Exchange) records tell email servers where to deliver email for your domain. Setting up MX records allows you to use your custom domain for email addresses like support@yourdomain.com.

Pricingâ

Abacus.AI provides a generous free tier for database, file hosting, and app server management until your app starts receiving significant traffic (up to 25,000 credits per month). Beyond that, charges apply. Read More.

If you already own a domain and want to connect it to Abacus.AI, please refer to our Custom Domains documentation here.

Toolbar Options Documentation

What is the Toolbar feature in ChatLLM?â

The Toolbar feature in ChatLLM allows users to enhance their custom ChatLLM with additional functionalities such as Image Generation, Doc Generation, and more. This field is optional and only required if you want your custom ChatLLM to showcase a toolbar.

How can I control the context of the LLM for the toolbar?â

You can control the context of the LLM to use for the toolbar as follows:

  • Enable Web Search: Allows the LLM to perform web search requests and fetch pages when responding to questions that require access to recent or specific information. Not all questions will result in web requests, only those that the model determines will benefit from access to information. This initial determination step can add some additional latency to responses. Enabling this option may send data to alternate models. Do not enable this option if it is necessary to strictly control the models used.

  • Include General Knowledge: If you have attached a Doc Retriever, it would allow the LLM to access information from its training data to answer queries. Currently supports only Unstructured Data, doesn't support Structured Data.

What options are available in the Toolbar?â

The Toolbar offers a variety of options to enhance your ChatLLM experience:

OptionDescription
Video AnalysisAnalyzes video content to extract insights or data.
Scrape URLExtracts information from a specified web URL.
Video-GenGenerates video content based on input parameters.
HumanizeConverts GenAI text into something that is more human-like.
Doc-GenCreates documents from provided data or templates.
ImageHandles image-related tasks such as editing or generating images.
CodeAssists with coding tasks, including writing and debugging code.
Code playgroundAn interactive space for testing and experimenting with code or ideas.
EditorA tool for editing text or documents.
ScreenshotCaptures and manages screenshots.
Powerpoint-GenGenerates PowerPoint presentations from data or templates.

Instructions for LLM Behaviorâ

Behavior Instructions are directives that shape how the model approaches the problem to be solved. They are used to direct the choices and methods used by the LLM during the process of getting the answer. These instructions become more specific to the use case you are tackling.

Some examples for the different scenarios can be:

  • Answering Questions on a Document: To make the LLM perform a more focused query, you can say:
    "Use only the top search results while generating the answer."

  • Querying a Database: To make the LLM provide more background on the retrieved rows, you can say:
    "While writing SQL code try to retrieve related columns to provide more background to the results."

  • Using Web Search: To force the LLM to always perform a web search, you can say:
    "Always perform a web search before answering the query."

Response Instructionsâ

Response Instructions focus on the way the LLM responds to the user setting. They can be used to control format, persona, tone, as well as the structure of the answers that the LLM generates.

Here are a subset of aspects that you can control with response instructions:

  • Tone: Directing the model to be formal, casual, humorous, or empathetic.

  • Persona: Instructing the model to behave like a specific character or role, such as a technical expert, a friendly assistant, or a strict moderator.

  • Ethical Guidelines: Ensuring the model avoids certain topics, respects privacy, or adheres to community guidelines.

  • Engagement: Guiding the model to take initiative in the conversation, ask follow-up questions, or provide detailed explanations.

  • Length: Specifying the desired verbosity of the model's responses, from concise to detailed.

  • Complexity: Adjusting the complexity of the language used, which can be important for different audience levels.

  • Content: Directing the model to include or exclude certain types of information, such as examples, analogies, or references.

  • Clarification: Instructing the model on how to handle ambiguous or incomplete queries, such as asking for clarification or making educated guesses.

An example instruction would be:

"You are a professional consultant. Keep responses under three sentences unless elaborating on complex topics. Use bullet points for step-by-step instructions. Always confirm user understanding before moving on to the next step."

How do I enable (disable) the Toolbar feature?â

You can enable the Toolbar feature during the training or re-training step of chatbot creation. Similarly, please select "No" under Enable Tool Bar to disable this feature.

What should I consider before enabling Web Search?â

Before enabling Web Search, consider the following:

  • Enabling this option may send data to alternate models.

  • Ensure that it aligns with your data privacy and security requirements.

  • Be aware that enabling Web Search can introduce additional latency in responses.
